attorneys.name: Cheyenne Nicole Younger
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Defense & Protective Orders Lawyers in Lawrenceburg, IN
attorneys.bio:
Cheyenne Younger decided she was going to be a lawyer when she was a young girl and started on her path to making that dream a reality at an early age. She graduated from Bellarmine University in just 2 and a half years with Cum Laude honors, and went on to earn her Juris Doctorate from the Salmon P. Chase College of Law. Cheyenne was admitted to the Ohio Bar in October 2021 and the Indiana bar in November 2021.

Cheyenne started her legal career working in criminal defense. She immediately found her passion for fighting for those who have been accused of a crime and working to defend their reputations, their futures, and their families. Cheyenne began practicing at her own law firm right out of law school and in 2021 she joined Pillar Law Group LLP as a criminal defense lawyer and litigator. Cheyenne is an executive board member for 1Voice and has held this position since 2022.

As a criminal defense attorney, Cheyenne takes pride in giving every client and every case individualized attention and using her experience to help clients navigate their way through tough times. She has represented clients at jury trials, bench trials, hearings, and plea negotiations. Cheyenne has built a reputation as a tough and talented attorney who has the skill and the experience to fight for her clients.

Cheyenne dedicates a significant amount of time outside of normal work hours training and improving her skills. She enjoys spending time with her husband and their family and friends. Cheyenne is a lifelong Dearborn County and Lawrenceburg resident, and enjoys giving back to the community and staying involved.

attorneys.bio:
Matthew is a skilled attorney focusing his practice in DCS / CHINS defense, Family Law, Probate (including Adoptions, Estates and Guardianships) and Criminal Law. Matthew uses his comprehensive knowledge and experience to provide aggressive representation and sound legal advice for his clients.

Matthew graduated from Indiana University with a Bachelor of Science in Labor Studies, with high distinction. Thereafter, he graduated from Indiana University Robert H. McKinney School of Law. The combination of Matthew's education and real-world experience allows him to approach client matters with a unique prospective.

Matthew is a Member of the Indiana State Bar Association and the Indianapolis Bar Association. Matthew is a life time member of the Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. Matthew resides in Indianapolis and serves clients throughout the State of Indiana.

attorneys.name: Susan E. Ziel
attorneys.practice_type: Health Care Lawyers in Indianapolis, IN
attorneys.bio:
Susan Ziel is a nurse attorney and partner with the law firm of Krieg DeVault LLP. Ms. Ziel is a Core Member of both the Health Care and Life Sciences Practice Groups and she represents and advises the firm's clients regarding many significant legal and regulatory issues, including but not limited to, security breach incidents involving protected health information and other personal information; fraud and abuse allegations and related government audits, investigations and enforcement actions; and licensure, peer review and contractual matters.

In addition to serving as a regular speaker and author, Ms. Ziel is active in numerous professional organizations, including but not limited to, the American Bar Association (ABA), the American Health Lawyers Association (AHLA), The American Association of Nurse Attorneys (TAANA), the Medical Group Management Association (MGMA), the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), the Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA), the Health Care Compliance Association (HCCA) and Sigma Theta Tau, an international nursing honor society.

Ms. Ziel also serves on the Advisory Board of the University of Michigan School of Public Health's Center of Health, Law and Ethics and she currently serves as Chair of the Carmel Chamber of Commerce's Board of Directors and the American Heart Association Midwest Affiliate's Go Red for Women Executive Leadership Team. She is also a Past President of TAANA and Executive Women in Health Care (EWHC), among others.

Ms. Ziel is a graduate of Madonna University's School of Nursing, the University of Michigan's School of Public Health and the University of South Carolina's School of Law. She has also completed graduate studies at the Royal College of Nursing in London, England.

Ms. Ziel resides in Minneapolis, Minnesota with her husband, Daniel J. Pesut, PhD RN FAAN who serves as the Katherine R. and C. Walton Lillehei Chair in Nursing Leadership at the University of Minnesota School of Nursing, however she works out of the firm's Indiana and Minnesota offices in serving firm clients across the country.

attorneys.name: Patrick A. Ziepolt
attorneys.practice_type: Litigation Lawyers in Bloomington, IN
attorneys.bio:
Patrick Ziepolt is an attorney in Mallor Grodner Plummer Attorneys' business services and litigation practice areas. Patrick litigates on behalf of businesses and individuals. He appears in Indiana trial and appellate courts, Indiana federal courts, state licensing and disciplinary proceedings, arbitrations, and college and university proceedings. His work ranges from pre-suit negotiation through jury verdict through appeal to this State's highest court.

Patrick's experience in commercial law includes advocating for businesses, minority owners, and majority owners in breach-of-contract and fiduciary-duty disputes. He has defended and prosecuted complex negligence claims; he has enforced and defeated covenants not to compete. Patrick has worked on behalf of students in college and university disciplinary actions involving allegations of regulatory violations, violence, and sexual assault (Title IX). Patrick also has advised other attorneys, from individuals to 500-person firms, in malpractice and disciplinary matters. He has submitted appellate arguments on behalf of Indiana utilities and utility trade groups about government regulation and civil liability.

attorneys.practice_type: General Practice Lawyers in Evansville, IN
attorneys.bio:
Kendall Ziliak grew up in Posey County where she graduated from North Posey High School in 2013. She went on to attend Purdue University where she majored in Political Science and earned minors in both History and Philosophy. She graduated from Purdue in 3 ½ years with a 4.0 GPA. She then attended the Maurer School of Law at Indiana University-Bloomington. While in law school she received the CALI Excellence for the Future Award in Legislation, Administrative Law, and Domestic Relations Mediation. She also competed in the Sherman Minton Moot Court Competition, receiving an award for the best written brief and finishing as an octofinalist. She graduated from Maurer cum laude.

Upon graduation from law school, Kendall married Andrew Ziliak, a farmer in Fort Branch, Indiana. After having worked for Barber & Bauer, LLP for five years, first as an intern and then as a paralegal, she joined the firm as an associate in September 2020. When she is not practicing law, she enjoys spending time with her family, which includes fifteen nieces and nephews. She is also known for wanting a big family of her own and for bringing in homemade treats for the office.

attorneys.practice_type: Family Law Lawyers in Evansville, IN
attorneys.bio:
Holton A. Zoss was born and raised in Evansville, Indiana, and is proud to serve the community he calls home. He graduated from Central High School in 2019, where he distinguished himself as both a student and athlete, helping lead his football team to the state championship game during his senior year.

Holton continued his academic and athletic career at Morehead State University in Kentucky, earning his undergraduate degree in political science in just three years while competing in collegiate football. He went on to attend Southern Illinois University Simmons Law School in Carbondale, Illinois, where he again completed his legal education ahead of schedule.

During law school, he gained hands-on legal experience through internships with the Warrick County Prosecutor’s Office and the Vanderburgh County Public Defender’s Office, allowing him to develop a well-rounded perspective of the criminal justice system from both sides of the courtroom.

As the son of attorney Bob Zoss, Holton has been immersed in the legal profession from an early age. Since 2020, he has worked at Zoss Law LLC, learning the inner workings of a law firm and developing skills in case preparation, legal strategy, and client representation. Holton brings a strong work ethic, practical experience, and deep roots in the community to his practice.

attorneys.name: Robert E. Zoss
attorneys.practice_type: Adoption Lawyers in Evansville, IN
attorneys.bio:
Robert E. "Bob" Zoss Sr. was born and raised in South Bend, Ind. He is a 1967 graduate of Howe Military School, where he rose to the rank of cadet captain and was initially on the battalion staff and then a company commander. Upon his graduation, he attended Indiana University in Bloomington and completed his undergraduate degree in business management in only 3 years. Upon completion of his undergraduate studies, he was accepted to the Indiana University Law School in Bloomington, Ind., graduating with a juris doctorate degree in 1974.

He has been a resident of Evansville, Indiana, since 1974, initially working for a local law firm and then as a Deputy Prosecutor; a position he maintained for the last 35 years until his recent retirement from that office on March 16, 2012. During his some 35 years as a felony trial deputy, Bob has handled many murders and other high profile cases on behalf of the State of Indiana. He has successfully tried well over 150 jury trials for the Vanderburgh County Prosecutor's Office and several significant personal injury cases as well. He has been married to his wife, Heather, for more than 25 years and has 8 children and 6 grandchildren.

Throughout his years of practice, he has limited his focus to family law matters. His firm has also handled major personal injury cases and with his experience in criminal law, he is now accepting criminal defense cases, which he believes is a natural transition from his years as a deputy prosecutor. He maintains a reputation as being well prepared, aggressive, but also fair. He practices law with Terrell Maurer, Jeff Shoulders, Zach Winsett, and Keating Zoss.

With the extensive experience he has, Bob Zoss will actively undertake your representation in these areas, should you find that you need legal representation. Although he practices anywhere in Southern Indiana, his geographic practice areas mainly consist of Vanderburgh County, Gibson County, Warrick County, Posey County, Knox County, Pike County, Dubois County and Daviess County. However, he will travel if requested or required to do so.
